$comment: Pinned external sources. See vendor/README.md. Edit only via scripts/vendor_sync.py --update <name>.

cliproxy-models.description: CLIProxyAPI's published model list. SuperAI validates cliproxy:* registry rows against this instead of querying a live proxy or a live URL.

skipped.reason: 3.4x the size of models.json and redundant for our purpose: the codex ids SuperAI needs are already in models.json under the codex-free / codex-team / codex-plus / codex-pro keys.

vega.description: Vega / Vega-Lite / Vega-Embed runtime, inlined into generated chart HTML. Previously loaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net at floating major versions (vega@5), so a CDN publish could change every rendered chart with no commit here.
vega.pin_policy_note: Updates track the latest release WITHIN the pinned major (5/5/6). SuperAI emits specs declaring $schema vega-lite/v5.json; npm 'latest' is now vega 6.x / vega-lite 6.x / vega-embed 7.x, and taking it would silently change how existing specs render. Bumping a major is a deliberate change with chart re-testing, not a refresh.

cliproxy.description: The proxy itself. SuperAI speaks its OpenAI-compatible protocol over HTTP and reads none of its source, so nothing is vendored — only the reference is pinned so docs cite a fixed tag rather than a branch that moves daily.

mgmt-ui.description: The prebuilt single-file UI for Management Center. Unlike the proxy itself, which is reference-only, we ship these bytes so they can be served directly.
